_what_this_is: the inventory of capacity this installation BUILT and does not exercise. Five kinds, found by five different means, consolidated once
_why_it_matters: every entry is an extension point someone already fought for — it exists, it survived the upgrades, and it sits in the table a new design would write to. Rebuilding is waste; colliding is worse

1_custom_columns_empty_or_sparse.headline: 12 of 16 sparse columns are on PRPS and they are ONE design, not twelve fields

the_PRPS_block._what_it_is: a programmatic and donor classification of the WBS element: main strategy, programme, keywords, major commitment, sub-donor, beneficiary, type of country, coordinator, cooperating agency, point of contact
the_PRPS_block._status: built, survived every upgrade, holding almost nothing (max fill 0.61%)
the_PRPS_block._for_the_future_design: THE most valuable finding in this sweep. The dimensions a results-based reporting layer needs are already modelled on the WBS element

others.PPOIX.ZZSUBST_SPPRC: 0 of 1,302,607 — half a substitution mechanism was built

_CORRECTED_s098._what_was_wrong: reported as 'a whole classification layer built and never populated'. PRPS carries 31 YYE_* fields, not the 13 the sweep printed, and the block is in THREE different lifecycles

abandoned_over_24_years.curve: 82% of WBS elements created in 2002 down to 5% of those created in 2026
abandoned_over_24_years._reading: it WAS the practice. Something displaced it — worth knowing what

a_pilot_2016_2020._reading: three values is a specific co-financing arrangement, not a classification

new_and_growing._reading: despite the name it is a FLAG, not a point of contact, and ONE user fills it. Something started in 2022 and is being adopted now

what_displaced_the_donor.answer: NOTHING in SAP. The dimension left the WBS master

candidates_tested_and_refuted.Grants Management: GRANT_NBR holds ONE distinct value, blank, over 2,308,814 FM lines

what_actually_happened.2021: YYE_EXEC_AGENCY, YYE_IMPL_AGENCY and YYE_BENEF1 jump together from ~20% to 50% of new WBS elements, moving in LOCKSTEP — one process, not three decisions
what_actually_happened.2024: MULESOFT becomes the creator: 0% through 2022, 2% in 2023, then 85%, 78%, 81%. The WBS master is no longer written by people

what_the_interface_actually_fills.YYE_IMPL_AGENCY: ONE distinct value, 'UNESCO' — 92% filled and carrying no information
what_the_interface_actually_fills.YYE_EXEC_AGENCY: FOUR values, UNESCO/NEX/UNOPS/DEX — an execution MODALITY, not an agency
what_the_interface_actually_fills.YYE_BENEF1: 5,872 values shaped DDDDDDDDAAA (24221400CCH, 21214100HED) — a Core Planner workplan code. NOT a beneficiary and not a business partner: 0 of 5 sampled match BUT000, LFA1 or KNA1

what_displaced_the_donor._for_the_future_design: two of the three fields the interface fills are informationally empty and the only one with content is misnamed. A design reading this block by its field names will conclude the WBS is richly classified when it carries one planning code and two placeholders
what_displaced_the_donor._where_the_donor_probably_lives_now: the Core Planner (the PPM sibling in this ecosystem), which is also the source of the workplan codes now arriving in YYE_BENEF1. STATED AS THE NEXT PLACE TO LOOK, not as measured

2_custom_tables_empty._reading: consistent with the budget-rate PERSONNEL path being built and never adopted

3_configured_entries_that_post_nothing.T512T: 1,353 of 1,641 wage types (82.4%) produce nothing in 2026 real postings
3_configured_entries_that_post_nothing._window: measured against ppoix, which holds 2026 and posted runs only

4_a_named_mechanism_that_does_not_run.the_72_constant_dollar_wage_types: all configured in T512T/T512W/T52EL with identical setup, ZERO of them post. The difference is carried by one wage type, 999S

5_code_behind_a_disabled_switch.the_PBC_two_step_conversion: fully implemented, both call sites inside IF 1 = 2

_the_reframe: five independent kinds, found five different ways. Dormancy is the NORM in this installation, not an exception — which changes it from a list of defects into a map of available capacity
_the_honest_limit: this measures what the GOLDEN holds. For PRPS the claim is strong: 60,292 rows is the whole WBS master. For a column on a period-sliced table, 'empty' means 'empty in what we extracted'

the_measurement_defect_found_and_fixed.what: TEN of the 31 PRPS fields looked 100% FILLED and are not. A numeric or NUMC field is never blank — it defaults to zero — so trim(col)<>'' counts '0.00' and '00000000' as values
the_measurement_defect_found_and_fixed.worst_case: YYE_PRCTO showed 100% and is 0.45% real; YYE_RELEV showed 100% and is 3%
the_measurement_defect_found_and_fixed.fix: A18 strips zeros and dots before judging: trim(trim(col),'0.')<>''
the_measurement_defect_found_and_fixed.effect_on_the_sweep: 38/4/16 became 35/6/17, and PPDIT-ZZBTZNR and LFBK-YYFFCRTO turned out to be fully empty
the_measurement_defect_found_and_fixed._the_general_lesson: THE EMPTY VALUE OF A FIELD DEPENDS ON ITS TYPE. One emptiness test for every type is how a dormant field passes as a live one
